messages:
Camille Park: Quick flag 16: Meridian exec wants a 1-slide health pulse + one slide with 2 proposed remedies for onboarding slowdowns. Can we split?
Noah Jensen: Ill do the onboarding pulse: success rate, stuck flows, and top 2 bugs. Will run a 30-day query and drop numbers by EOD.
Avery Singh: Ill take remedy options and estimated impact (hours + delta in time-to-value). Thinking: dedicated onboarding sprints or targeted SDK patch.
Riley Gomez: Ill assemble the exec slide + a TL;DR headline. Exec likes a single metric, a trend, and one ask.
Camille Park: Also capture renewal risk categories (low/medium/high) and a suggested short-term incentive if risk >= medium. Keep incentive one-liner.
Noah Jensen: SQL Im running:
```
SELECT status, count(*) FROM integration_runs WHERE created_at > now() - interval '30 days' GROUP BY status;
```
Avery Singh: For impact calc Ill assume 2-week sprint reduces onboarding time by ~30% and surface cost of support hours.
ops-bot: Reminder: slide freeze set for Tue 6pm PT.
Camille Park: Thanks team. Owners recap: Noah = onboarding numbers + feedback snippet; Avery = remedies + impact; Riley = exec slide + TL;DR. Ill coordinate rehearsal Tue 11:45am PT. :thumbsup:
Riley Gomez: Scheduling note: can we keep total deck <= 5 slides? Exec wants brevity.
Camille Park: Yes 1-2 slides core, 2-3 appendix. Ill share link when draft ready.
